Not always on

Your classes run on your energy

The Invitation and Mission to Millions fill when you show up and promote them. Between pushes, a woman who saves your reels has no class being put in front of her that day.

No daily path

Your recorded work waits to be found

Your recorded programmes are the natural first purchase for the 95%, but nothing walks a new follower towards them every day, at the moment she is most interested.

No filter

Every conversation starts cold

Without an application step after the class, you can’t tell the woman who is ready to invest in herself from the one who is just curious until you are already talking.

Attraction brings women to you. Right now, they only land when you are pushing.
